search_text: published ZDI-26-522 ZDI-CAN-27763 Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3000 Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2026-07-30 CVE-2026-41032 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-41032 6.5 AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N ['Phoenix Contact'] ['CHARX SEC-3000'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3000 devices. title: Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3000 Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Phoenix Contact CHARX SEC-3000 devices. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the generation of log files. The issue results from including sensitive information in a log file. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise.
